caption: The drawing shows a single ceramic mug placed centrally within a square border on a light, beige background. The mug is rendered in grayscale pencil or ink, with detailed shading to depict its cylindrical shape. The mug has a rounded, bulbous base with horizontal bands. The body of the mug features a wide, central band with a repeated pressed pattern of X-shapes and dots. Above and below the patterned band are plain sections, with the top section marked by horizontal lines. The handle of the mug is attached at the top and bottom right, curling in a loop and shaded to indicate a rounded form. The name "Capelli" is written in small print at the bottom left corner inside the border. There are faint pink-red marks or smudges in the bottom-right corner of the drawing, outside the mug’s form. The drawing uses fine, precise lines and subtle shading for a three-dimensional effect.
title: Mug
